title: aspalathus polycephala subsp. rigida
intro: Aspalathus polycephala subsp. rigida, commonly known as Rooibos sub-species, is a type of shrub that is native to South Africa. It has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and heart disease. The therapeutic actions of Aspalathus polycephala subsp. rigida include acting as an anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and aspalathin, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
